observations.why: Imperative verb enacts a command directing the recipient to alter their knowledge state — hierarchy performed through directive speech.
Imperative construction commands erasure of information from the recipient's knowledge base — authority-ranking enacted through a deletion directive.

mints.name: DirectiveKnowledgeErasure
mints.title: Remove all knowledge about the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration
mints.frame: Is the speaker commanding the recipient to alter or delete what they know, rather than merely informing or requesting?
